escena: SCENE (cinematic, epic scale, slight low camera angle, a vast dark space at night with haze, like an empty arena): Karo, wearing the ROYAL-BLUE EFEONCE HOODIE, stands on the RIGHT side of the frame, framed from the waist up; her left shoulder is at about 62 % of the frame width and a wide band of empty darkness runs between the left edge of the frame and her body; camera about four meters away at chest height, 85mm f/2, REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS. Behind her, receding for hundreds of meters into the darkness on the right half of the frame, an immense field of THOUSANDS of tiny dark phone screens hangs in the air in rows, all unlit, like an audience waiting. THE MOMENT: she has just launched one vertical ad from the phone she holds up at shoulder height on the frame-right side of her face: from the phone, three dead-straight, precise beams of azure-blue (#0375DB) and white light shoot back into the depth, and only where each beam lands does one compact cluster of a few dozen phone screens light up bright white, while all the others stay dark. At the very start of the beams, right above her phone, the launched ad glows as one small vertical frame with a single orange (#FF6500) dot at its center, the only accent in the frame, lighting nothing around it. Head almost frontal, only her eyes turn up toward the launched ad frame just above her phone, a confident, focused half-smile. A long dark matte console runs between the camera and her, its near edge just in front of the lens. The beams, the clusters and every screen stay inside the RIGHT 50% of the frame. The LEFT 50% is calm, deep dark space with faint haze only. Enormous contrast, no readable text, no logos of any other brand.
